# A flag planted at each landing: a pole 0.9 m and a cream pennant. Origin at the pole's foot.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pole --base-color 0.306 0.286 0.373 --no-slot
material new Cloth --base-color 0.965 0.839 0.741 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Pole --size 1 --location 0 0 0.45
scale 0.08 0.08 0.9
apply --scale
material assign Pole
add mesh cube --name Cloth --size 1 --location 0.22 0 0.74
scale 0.4 0.06 0.26
apply --scale
material assign Cloth
select all
shade flat
export flag.glb
